eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, w = g.weapon, inp = g.input, t = g.tools, b = g.builder; g.edits.clear(); window.__tick = (n) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); t.update(1 / 30); g.felled.update(1 / 30, p.position); inp.endFrame(); } }; const tall = { name: 'Torre alta', height: 20, cost: 80, legs: 1.8 }; const ok = (x, z) => [[0, 0], [0.8, 0], [-0.8, 0], [0, 0.8], [0, -0.8]].every(([ox, oz]) => b.check(x + ox, z + oz, tall) === 'faltam 80 de madeira'); const o = p.position.clone(); const cam = g.engine.camera; const d = new cam.position.constructor(); let S = null; for (let r = 14; r < 300 && !S; r += 6) for (let a = 0; a < 16 && !S; a++) { const x = o.x + Math.cos(a * 0.39) * r, z = o.z + Math.sin(a * 0.39) * r; if (!ok(x, z)) continue; const dx = (x - o.x) / r, dz = (z - o.z) / r; const px = x - dx * 9, pz = z - dz * 9; if (!g.chunks.isClear(px, pz, 0.5) || !g.terrain.lakes.dry(px, pz, 1)) continue; p.position.set(px, g.terrain.heightAt(px, pz), pz); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(x - px), -(z - pz)); p.pitch = 0; g.chunks.warmup(p.position); __tick(2); let best = null; for (let pt = -0.7; pt <= 0.1; pt += 0.002) { d.set(-Math.sin(p.yaw) * Math.cos(pt), Math.sin(pt), -Math.cos(p.yaw) * Math.cos(pt)); const hit = g.terrain.raycast(cam.position, d, 20, 0.5); if (!(hit <= 20)) continue; const hx = cam.position.x + d.x * hit, hz = cam.position.z + d.z * hit; const e = Math.hypot(hx - x, hz - z); if (!best || e < best.e) best = { e, pt, hx, hz }; } if (!best || !ok(best.hx, best.hz)) continue; p.pitch = best.pt; S = { x: best.hx, z: best.hz, px, pz, e: best.e }; } __tick(3); localStorage.setItem('__S', JSON.stringify(S)); return { lugar: { x: +S.x.toFixed(1), z: +S.z.toFixed(1) }, olhar: +p.pitch.toFixed(3), erroDaMira: +S.e.toFixed(2) }; })()
label: lugar plano e aberto a 11 m, olhando para ele

eval: (() => { const g = game, b = g.builder, tall = { name: 'Torre alta', height: 20, cost: 80, legs: 1.8 }; const p = g.player.position; const o = []; g.terrain.lakes.near(p.x, p.z, 900, o); const lake = o[0]; let tree = null; for (const c of g.chunks.loaded.values()) { c.treeRefs.forEach((r, k) => { if (r && !tree && g.terrain.places.clear(c.trunks[k * 4], c.trunks[k * 4 + 1], 8)) tree = { x: c.trunks[k * 4] + 0.5, z: c.trunks[k * 4 + 1] }; }); if (tree) break; } const pl = []; g.terrain.places.near(p.x, p.z, 3000, pl); const place = pl.find((q) => !q.own); let steep = null; for (let r = 5; r < 400 && !steep; r += 7) for (let a = 0; a < 12 && !steep; a++) { const x = p.x + Math.cos(a * 0.52) * r, z = p.z + Math.sin(a * 0.52) * r; if (b.check(x, z, tall) === 'chão inclinado demais') steep = { x, z }; } return { agua: lake ? b.check(lake.x, lake.z, tall) : 'sem lago perto', arvore: b.check(tree.x, tree.z, tall), lugar: place ? b.check(place.x, place.z, tall) : 'sem lugar', ladeira: steep ? b.check(steep.x, steep.z, tall) : 'sem ladeira perto' }; })()
label: motivos de não poder
